_comment: Shared base for tag templates with a custom dimension id field (piwik*, ecommerce_*, video_html5). Extends tag_base and adds guidance for fields that reference Analytics custom dimensions.

custom_dimension_id_guide.overview: Tag fields that reference a session/event custom dimension take its integer ID, shown as 'ID' in Analytics > Settings > Custom dimensions.
custom_dimension_id_guide.source_of_truth: Call analytics_custom_dimensions_list(website_id, scope='session' or 'event', limit=1000), match by name and copy data[].attributes.tracking_id.
custom_dimension_id_guide.warning: For session/event dimensions, do not use data[].id (a UUID for the management API) or data[].attributes.slot (internal storage slot). Neither is the ID used in Tag Manager.
custom_dimension_id_guide.product_dimensions: Product dimensions (product_dimensions[].id) use attributes.slot. Call analytics_custom_dimensions_list(website_id, scope='product'), match by name and copy data[].attributes.slot.

invalid: a session/event dimension's slot number (slot is valid only for product_dimensions[].id)
